conditions.today: 6 AM- Make plans for a moody Tuesday in the mountains, Jackson Hole. Patchy cloud cover blown by moderate winds will move strange shadows across the white forest floor, enticing you to taste a tiny piece of something slightly off-piste. Go for it and add an extra aspect of adventure to the day. A fast-moving shower may make a surprise appearance but shouldn't disrupt any of your on-slope play, because warm temperatures will welcome you all along the way. Expect the summit to soar near 40 degrees while Teton Village pushes close to 60. Gusty winds from the west will be whistling through the trees and crags as they blow between 5 and 30 mph. Enjoy the continuing cascade of contrasts. -Lege
conditions.yesterday: Start your week off right by embracing the spring slush vibes at Rendezvous Mountain. A monster high pressure system remains parked over the west, keeping things warm and dry, but a healthy base, a positive attitude, and endless terrain are our recipe for success. Expect consistent high cloud cover throughout the day today. Westerly Winds will be moderate with gusts up to 25mph possible along the ridge tops. Summit temps will kick around the 40s while the base gets tropical at 61 degrees by mid-day. Come and get it! -OH
